rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for strongly denouncing a person, group, or action.

example.english: People from all walks of life strongly condemn this cold-blooded act.
example.traditional: 社會各界紛紛聲討呢種冷血行為。
example.jyutping: se5 wui6 gok3 gaai3 fan1 fan1 seng1 tou2 ni1 zung2 laang5 hyut3 hang4 wai4

rows.note: Use this specifically when a court sentences someone to a punishment.

example.english: If they are found guilty, the court will condemn them to three years in prison.
example.traditional: 如果罪名成立，法庭會判刑三年。
example.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 zeoi6 ming4 sing4 lap6 faat3 ting4 wui5 pun3 jing4 saam1 nin4

rows.note: Use this when someone or something is destined to suffer a bad fate or condition.

example.english: If they carry on like this, they will condemn themselves to a lifetime of poverty.
example.traditional: 佢哋再咁樣落去，就注定一世捱窮㗎喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zoi3 gam2 joeng2 lok6 heoi3 zau6 zyu3 ding6 jat1 sai3 ngaai4 kung4 gaa3 laa3

rows.note: Use this formal phrase when an authority declares something unfit or unsuitable for further use.

example.english: After inspection, the authority may condemn this machine as unfit for further use.
example.traditional: 經檢查，當局判定不適用嘅就係呢部機。
example.jyutping: ging1 gim2 caa4 dong1 guk6 pun3 ding6 bat1 sik1 jung6 ge3 zau6 hai6 ni1 bou6 gei1
